fusions.name: Spoken Barb
fusions.desc: Casts a barbed word at the first enemy it meets that deals 9 damage and has a 50% chance to leave the target [Spell Impetus] for 6 seconds. It needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up.

fusions.name: Threefold Word
fusions.desc: Looses 3 bolts of arcane force at once, spread apart, each dealing 9 damage that ignores resistances.

fusions.name: Corrected Spell
fusions.desc: Turns afflictions back on whoever inflicts them: each debuff laid on you has a 55% chance to be sent back to its source instead, for 7 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed Form
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 7% sooner. Your armour rises by 5%.
